correctness.rationale: Two-valued coordinate bound follows exactly from e2-x_i e1+x_i^2=0. Separate congruence calculations prove that the gradient zero scheme lies on support lines or two-block planes and determine the restriction e3=(ua+vb)^3. Substitution and Lucas congruences yield the exhaustive set-theoretic 9-periodic list. The Hessian has ranks n-2 on two-block planes and n-1 on support lines in other residues, proving local smoothness of the gradient scheme, hence local length 3 when cut by a cubic power or length 1 otherwise. Counting complementary partitions gives the degrees. Exact small-field experiments corroborate but do not prove infinite statements. For n=2 mod9 no embedded intersection classification is asserted.

value.rationale: Elementary symmetric singularities have intrinsic geometric and formula-complexity motivation; the source explicitly leaves smaller-component structure open. The theorem provides complete reduced support across all n in degree three/characteristic three, a precise nine-residue phase diagram, and nontrivial new antipodal noncoordinate components with exact scheme multiplicity (n=8: 35 additional points, total scheme degree 129). These are natural exact invariants of the singular hypersurface, beyond a parameter reindexing or isolated computation.
